verdict.rationale: Insomnia's import/export docs list a broad set of import formats: its own Insomnia JSON v4 and YAML v5, plus Postman v2.0/v2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL and cURL. Import works via File, Clipboard or URL, which covers moving collections in from other tools. Export appears only in the import-export page title; no item says which formats can be exported. missing for 10: explicit documentation of export formats (e.g., exporting to Postman/HAR/Insomnia YAML), independent or hands-on corroboration of round-trip portability
